None eliminates the remaining environment-sensitive compile/test/dependency or protected/privileged execution residual under zero Work/manual steps, zero finite quota dependence and zero incremental cost. exact_next_candidate: Prioritize a newly durable source-qualified mechanism that directly closes one still-uncovered residual class: (A) arbitrary environment-sensitive compile/test/dependency execution, or (B) protected/privileged effect execution. Require empirical evidence that the exact route uses zero Work/protected/manual-user steps, has a deterministic non-human terminal policy for every unattended permission state, depends on no finite monthly/trial/paid quota, has zero incremental monetary cost, survives invocation boundaries/rate limits by checkpoint-resume, and uses durable business/post-condition completion plus authority reconciliation rather than process/transport-only success. Separately seek an actual multi-host/network-partition fencing case to strengthen FE-467 beyond shared-store simulation.
scope_guard: All classifications are limited to the exact source artifact and quoted tested scopes. Open issues are treated as counterexamples/observations, not shipped fixes. No family-wide rejection, repository-wide absence claim, benchmark superiority claim or Phase1 closure claim is made.
